pattern: SELECT MIN\(.*\) FROM Highschooler h WHERE h.ID NOT IN \(\s*( SELECT student_id|friend_id)\s*FROM\s*Friend\)
correction: Replace with: SELECT min(grade) FROM Highschooler WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT T1.student_id FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.id)

metadata.description: This rule corrects incorrect joins between tables in a SQL query.
